question: Why does auto-match require an exact amount match instead of allowing a small tolerance?
expected_answer: A 0.5% tolerance was tried in beta and caused false matches on recurring payments of similar size, so it was removed before 2.3.0.
evidence: Auto-match requires an exact amount match and a date within 7 days. We tried a 0.5% tolerance in beta and it caused false matches on recurring payments of similar size, so it was removed before 2.3.0.
notes: official auto-match-rules says WHAT (exact match); only the internal note says WHY
